## Architectures

<a id="anygpt"></a>

### AnyGPT

Understands and generates text, images, speech and music using a shared token vocabulary.

**Architecture:** Discrete multimodal token modeling on a language backbone.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.12226) · [Code](https://github.com/OpenMOSS/AnyGPT) · [Weights](https://huggingface.co/OpenMOSS-Team/AnyGPT-chat)

**License unclear:** code [Not stated](https://github.com/OpenMOSS/AnyGPT/blob/main/README.md) · weights [Apache-2.0 + Llama 2 terms](https://huggingface.co/OpenMOSS-Team/AnyGPT-chat/blob/c8999624b077b3837f32c3948f0f9e90bd67b860/README.md) — Base-model community terms also apply; repository-wide code licensing is not stated.

<a id="audio-visual-flamingo"></a>

### Audio-Visual Flamingo

Explains long videos by reasoning jointly about visual events and their soundtracks.

**Architecture:** Temporally interleaved audiovisual encoders and language decoder.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.16107) · [Code](https://github.com/lashahub/transformers/tree/add_AudioVisualFlamingo) · [Weights](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/nemotron-labs-audio-visual-flamingo-hf)

**Custom / restricted:** code [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/lashahub/transformers/blob/add_AudioVisualFlamingo/LICENSE) · weights [NVIDIA OneWay Noncommercial](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/nemotron-labs-audio-visual-flamingo-hf/blob/4e40cc207574b8d95628f44691f75b01e012e46c/README.md) — Noncommercial terms apply to model weights and relevant bundled components.

![Audio-Visual Flamingo — Figure 2](../assets/architectures/audio-visual-flamingo.png)

*Figure 2 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.16107)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T, I, V, A → T · **Interaction:** text-output

The public checkpoint returns text. The paper figure additionally depicts a streaming TTS module at the system level; it is not counted as native checkpoint speech output.

**Variants:** nemotron-labs-audio-visual-flamingo-hf.

</details>

<a id="br-voice-reasoner"></a>

### BR-Voice-Reasoner

Answers spoken knowledge and reasoning questions using a speech-adapted Qwen3-Omni Thinker.

**Architecture:** On-policy distillation of audio-language projection modules.

[Code](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/tree/main/src/transformers/models/qwen3_omni_moe) · [Weights](https://huggingface.co/brgroup/BR-Voice-Reasoner)

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T, I, V, A → T · **Interaction:** text-output

Distills audio-language projections of Qwen3-Omni Thinking. Visual inputs are inherited from the backbone; the reported evaluation focuses on speech.
